Name: Scarecrows As Sprinklers
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15385/]Sprinkler Mod[/url]﻿ that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to add three entries to the Sprinkler Mod dictionary, letting scarecrows, rarecrows, and deluxe scarecrows act as sprinklers.

The default radius for each type is:

[list]
[*]Scarecrow: 3
[*]Rarecrow: 5
[*]Deluxe Scarecrow: 7
[/list]
These values can be changed in the config.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config.json file created after running the game or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15385/]Sprinkler Mod[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
